component.name: QuadCast 2 S Lighting
component.summary: Control the RGB lighting on a HyperX QuadCast 2 S microphone

description.p: Drives the 108 addressable LEDs on a HyperX QuadCast 2 S microphone: a ring of twelve on top and a body of ninety-six arranged as twelve columns of eight. The vendor software is Windows-only; the protocol here was worked out by probing the hardware directly.
Ten effects, each of which can run on the ring and the body independently:

ul.li: Solid, blink, cycle, wave and vertical colour sweeps
A comet spinning around the twelve columns
A fire simulation up the body
Rain falling through the ring into the body

description.p: Settings can be saved as named presets, and one can be started automatically at login. The microphone does not hold a frame, so the lighting stays only while the program runs.
Starting automatically, and recovering by itself.

ul.li: Three independent start triggers: at login, when the microphone is connected, and keep-running.
The lighting comes back on its own after the machine sleeps or the microphone is unplugged.
The graphical front end now drives the service rather than competing with it.
